remarks: Welcome to 66 Stanton Road. Set on 1.34 landscaped acres, this classic 1938 clapboard colonial blends architectural charm with thoughtful updates, including a full renovation and expansion completed in 2009. Designed for effortless living and entertaining, the home offers refined formal rooms and relaxed gathering spaces. A gracious foyer with sweeping curved staircase is flanked by sunlit living and dining rooms. The open kitchen and family room anchor the home, featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, double ovens, a walnut island, generous pantry, and casual dining area. A vaulted, wood-paneled family room with exposed beams, fireplace, and a wall of windows overlooks the backyard. A wet bar with second dishwasher and built-in desk sits just off the kitchen. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing area, reading porch, and spa-like bath with steam shower and soaking tub. Five additional bedrooms include two en suites and a Jack-and-Jill layout, plus a flexible lounge/study area and walk-up attic storage. The lower level includes a bar, fireplace lounge, climate-controlled wine room, and full gym. Outdoor living shines with a screened porch, patio with grill, and a recently added gunite pool with spa and electric cover. Lush lawns and vibrant plantings create privacy and seasonal color for both quiet enjoyment and lively gatherings.
